node.statement: Ha lower-modulus estimate. For every Z in M_n tensor S_{P,R}, exact amplified adjointness, amplified product defect, the assumed diagonal anchor through lem-hcb3-diagonal-lower-modulus, and node 1.2 imply ||T_n(Z)||^2 >= (1-A*e)||Z||^2 and hence ||T_n(Z)|| >= (1-A*e)||Z||.
